summary: ESPN enrichment pipeline (Pass 1) — BACKEND 13/13 GREEN, FRONTEND HOME TAB CONFIRMED RENDERING ESPN LOGOS. Backend pytest (/app/backend/tests/test_espn_enrichment_iter66.py, JUnit /app/test_reports/pytest/iter66_espn_enrichment.xml): demo login works, /api/picks/today returns 170 picks with 65 carrying home_meta.logo hosted on https://a.espncdn.com/i/teamlogos/*, no Mongo _id leak. Admin refresh endpoints (uefa-espn-refresh, ufc-espn-refresh, espn-team-meta-refresh, espn-injury-refresh) all return 200 with real work done: injury refresh reports NFL total_injuries=800, CFB=27, NBA=127 across all 32/23/27 teams. Mongo state at end of run: espn_team_meta=626 docs (>500 target), espn_injury_notes=82 team-injury docs, picks(source=uefa_espn_v1)=88 (>80 target), picks(source=ufc_espn_v1)=1. Frontend: after logging in as demo@lockscore.ai / demo123 on mobile viewport (390x844), the home tab (/) rendered 128 elements with src starting `https://a.espncdn.com/i/teamlogos/` (samples: countries/mar.png, countries/fra.png, mlb/chc.png, mlb/bal.png, mlb/bos.png). Sample rendered card visually shows Morocco @ France with country flag crests on both sides plus abbreviations. Rollover/Under/Lab tabs use the same PickEventRow component so identical enrichment applies — visual verification for those tabs was blocked by /api/auth/login rate limiting on repeated login attempts, but code-level flow is identical. Console emitted only two deprecation warnings (`shadow*` style props → boxShadow, `props.pointerEvents` → style.pointerEvents) — no red errors.

minor.issue: 0/170 picks carry a truthy injury_chip today. Expected — today's slate has only Soccer/MLB/Tennis picks, and injury_chip is only populated for NFL/NBA/CFB in the decorator. When those sports enter the slate the chip will populate (per iter's admin refresh, 954 total injuries are sitting in espn_injury_notes ready to use).

Rate limiter still trips HTTP 429 on rapid re-login (carry-over from iter64/65). Regression tests handle with a 30s sleep + retry, but multiple concurrent browser/Playwright login attempts in the same window get denied.
